sourceNotes.referenceTitle: Silver-Plated Floral Nath – Shimmering White Zirconia Studded
sourceNotes.rawContent: Dazzle with this silver-toned floral nath, intricately studded with sparkling white zirconia. This high-fashion accessory is perfect for adding a modern ethnic touch to any look. To maintain its brilliant shine, keep it away from moisture and perfumes, and store it safely in a dry place after use.
